costs.name: se2-synthetic-notice-duration-1
costs.source: docs/formal-cost-model-and-horizon/main.tex; assumed 400 B/s management channel, not hardware measurements; SE2 notice: base phase durations multiplied by 1, 96 bytes unchanged

provenance.costScaling: Every security phase duration and management-byte count multiplied by the same positive integer; management radio B/s unchanged, CPU and elapsed overhead increase together. Payload unchanged. Model sensitivity, not hardware calibration.
provenance.payloadOnlyServiceCeilingMeaning: Required complete frames fit the original window without any security overhead; optimistic geometry-only bound, not achieved service or a key-feasibility guarantee
provenance.selection: First 3 windows in the verified chronological schedule; original IDs and nanosecond timestamps unchanged
provenance.traffic: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: 100 B/s, 1000 B complete frames (10 s). One frame offered and required per direction per contact. Useful time is demand-capped at 20 s/contact, not link utilization.

resources.source: frozen Java rules, not JSON capacity parameters
resources.radio: One shared uplink/downlink management/payload radio; per-phase reservations rechecked by executor
resources.spare: Generator blocks PREPARE when any PRE_ACTIVE material or pending PREPARE exists for that context; one spare pair on generated paths, not a total storage/RAM bound
resources.waiting: WAIT reserves no resource; already committed work is preserved

boundary: bytesPerSecond is modeled payload throughput; null window.linkRateBps is not replaced by a measured radio bitrate. SATNOGS IDs are identifiers, not inferred station names.
